page.overview:
Who is Real Emotion / 1000 no Kotoba?

"Real Emotion" / "1000 no Kotoba" (1000の言葉, Sen no Kotoba; lit. "1000 Words") is the seventh single by Japanese singer-songwriter Koda Kumi, released as a double A-side single.

Both "Real Emotion" and "1000 no Kotoba (1000 Words)" were featured in the video game Final Fantasy X-2, of which Koda provided the voice to the character Lenne. This was Koda's first single to chart in the top 10 on Oricon, coming in at No. 3.

Since its release, it has sold over 283,000 copies.
